headline: 54% of enterprises hit by AI agent security incidents AI agent security gap grows
summary: Enterprises struggle with AI agent security, 54% experiencing incidents
details: A recent VentureBeat Pulse Research survey of 107 enterprises reveals a significant gap in AI agent security. The study found that 54% of organizations have already experienced a confirmed AI agent security incident or a near-miss.

The survey highlights that only about a third of enterprises give every AI agent its own scoped, managed identity, while the rest report that some agents share credentials or run on shared API keys and human or service-account credentials.

Enterprises are satisfied with their current security stack, which is largely borrowed from model providers and hyperscalers, but spending on agent security remains a small portion of the overall security budget.
caption:
Can AI agent security keep pace with AI-enabled attackers?

A recent VentureBeat Pulse Research survey of 107 enterprises reveals a significant gap in AI agent security. The study found that 54% of organizations have already experienced a confirmed AI agent security incident or a near-miss.

The survey highlights that only about a third of enterprises give every AI agent its own scoped, managed identity, while the rest report that some agents share credentials or run on shared API keys and human or service-account credentials.

Enterprises are satisfied with their current security stack, which is largely borrowed from model providers and hyperscalers, but spending on agent security remains a small portion of the overall security budget.

#AI #SECURITY #TECH

Source: VentureBeat
